texts: Sky-cats hunted at the Sunken Cove on day 667, on day 668 and on day 669 of Year 2.
On day 670 of Year 2, Bevin Coombe asked the Council for permission to burn wintergloss at the Stilllight Lantern for one night.
Bevin Coombe burned wintergloss alongside the mire-essence of the Stilllight Lantern at sundown.
The wintergloss repelled nightmoths from the Stilllight Lantern.
Bevin Coombe counted three nightmoths at the Stilllight Lantern that night.
About twelve nightmoths gather at the Stilllight Lantern on a normal night.
The sky-cats did not descend into the Sunken Cove that night.
Bevin Coombe reported the result to the Council.

q1_issues.issue: The non-finite "to burn ..." complement is sealed under Theme, but the instruction set restricts sealing to finite clausal complements ("a control verb with a to-infinitive never seals"), and the requested object "permission" is dropped entirely — no permission witness and no oblique for "asked ... for permission" — with its content re-expressed as a (Permitted sk_burn_1) status inside the seal.

(Cardinality sk_group_4 (ParticleFromNormal 12 1.2)) puts a distribution in Cardinality's value slot, which is specified as a native integer; ParticleFromNormal is licensed only in Measure-family magnitude slots and approximate clock-time values.

(Inheritance normal_night night) — with (Inheritance normal_night normal) at 79 — puts in a class position the symbol statement 77 uses as an individual time filler, and "a normal night" is incidental description, which the adjective+noun fuse test excludes from compounding in the first place.

(Agent sk_repel_1 wintergloss) fills a role slot for the specific definite "The wintergloss" with the bare class symbol, which the instruction set reserves for non-specific/generic fillers and bars for a specific definite individual.

q2_gaps: "ask X for permission to V" — a request frame whose prepositional object is the noun "permission" taking an infinitival complement; nothing settles whether the requested act rides the noun's For-complement as a tenseless top-level event, a seal, or a deontic status atom

an approximated count ("about twelve nightmoths") — exact Cardinality requires a native integer and CardinalityPhrase is for vague words carrying no number, so a hedged numeral count has no licensed form
a typicality frame adverbial ("on a normal night") characterizing a habitual occasion — it is neither a calendar Time slot, an Every/TimesPer period or rate, nor a ConditionalProperty condition

a definite anaphor whose antecedent was licensed as a bare kind filler ("burn wintergloss" ... "The wintergloss repelled ...") — reusing the kind symbol puts a class in an individual role slot, while minting a fresh witness breaks the coreference
review.notes: The negated group sentence is handled exactly per doctrine (strength-0 group bundle plus the strength-0 per-member rule, time atoms inside), as are the Sunken Cove / Stilllight Lantern name-plus-kind atoms, the bare-plural episodic group witnesses, and the Theme/Patient splits on approve, produce, count and record. Alongside is a legitimate preposition-named oblique, so no head is unlicensed.

issues.reason: 'Sealing is finite-clause-only' is stated flatly ('A control verb with a to-infinitive never seals'), and the instruction set does supply a skeleton here — a prepositional verb's object is its preposition-named oblique, so '(Member sk_permission_1 permission)' + '(For sk_ask_1 sk_permission_1)' with the burn eventuality reified at top level, tenseless and status-free, per the noun's argument-PP rule — while this parse seals a non-finite complement under Theme, drops the requested object 'permission' entirely, and re-expresses it as a '(Permitted sk_burn_1)' status inside the seal.

Cardinality's value slot is specified as 'a native integer', and ParticleFromNormal is licensed only in Measure-family magnitude slots and the approximate clock-time value slot, so '(Cardinality sk_group_4 (ParticleFromNormal 12 1.2))' is ill-typed — and it breaks the hard-integer Compute test the counting-question machinery runs on a bound Cardinality.

This is the reviewer's own typicality-frame gap and every atom emitted there is true of the content; the instruction set's own 'room_temperature' precedent puts a fused circumstantial symbol in a NON-class slot while emitting its Inheritance genus ('(ConditionalProperty metal solid room_temperature)' + '(Inheritance room_temperature temperature)'), and the modifier-genus rule then mandates '(Inheritance normal_night normal)' because 'normal' is a gradable adjective predicable of the night — the incidental-description bar targets descriptive modifiers on referents whose members would otherwise be miscalled, not a circumstantial constant that has no members.

'Reserve the bare class symbol for a non-specific / generic object …, never for a specific definite individual' — 'The wintergloss' is the specific quantity just burned, and the definite-mass route ('the cake' -> '(Member sk_cake_1 cake)') shows the licensed encoding, so the kind symbol in '(Agent sk_repel_1 wintergloss)' puts a class in an individual role slot.

gaps_confirmed: 'ask X for permission to V': the For-oblique plus the noun's argument-PP machinery gives a skeleton, but nothing says how a deontic noun's INFINITIVAL complement attaches, nor how the permission relation reaches the requested act — the one thing the sentence is about.

An approximated count ('about twelve nightmoths'): Cardinality requires a native integer, CardinalityPhrase is for a numberless vague word, and CardinalityAtLeast/AtMost are bounds, so a hedged numeral count has no licensed carrier.
A typicality frame adverbial ('on a normal night') characterizing a habitual occasion: it is neither a calendar Time slot, an Every/TimesPer period or rate, nor a ConditionalProperty condition.

A definite anaphor whose antecedent was licensed as a bare kind filler ('burn wintergloss' … 'The wintergloss repelled …'): reusing the constant puts a class in an individual slot and minting a witness severs the coreference — the definite rule itself is clear, so what is missing is any way to link a definite back to a constant antecedent.
new_gaps: Coordinated date adjuncts on one clause ('hunted at the Sunken Cove on day 667, on day 668 and on day 669 of Year 2'): Coordination covers coordinated clauses, VPs and NPs, but nothing says whether coordinated temporal adjuncts give one event with several Time atoms (self-contradictory here) or one event per day, as this parse chose.

A re-lexicalized definite event noun naming a previously described eventuality ('the test', 'the result'): the event-anaphora rule covers only a pronoun pointing at a clause, so nothing identifies sk_test_1 with the burning it names — 'approved the test' and 'recorded the test' end up unconnected to the act they are about, and sk_result_1 unconnected to the count.
adjudication.defect_summary: Request frame: the compliant form types and obliques the requested object — '(Member sk_permission_1 permission)' '(For sk_ask_1 sk_permission_1)' — and reifies the burn event at top level with its roles, Location and duration Measure but NO tense and NO status atom, with no seal and no '(Permitted sk_burn_1)'; how the permission relation reaches that act is the gap filed above. Hedged count: no licensed form exists for 'about twelve', so the compliant parse emits the group and the gather event without a count atom and records the gap, rather than typing a distribution into an integer slot. Definite mass: mint '(Member sk_wintergloss_1 wintergloss)' at the burning (a specific quantity taking part in that occurrence) and reuse it — '(Patient sk_burn_2 sk_wintergloss_1)', '(Agent sk_repel_1 sk_wintergloss_1)' — which both types the definite as an individual and keeps the coreference.
adjudication.notes: The negated group sentence (strength-0 bundle plus strength-0 per-member rule, time atoms inside), the 'that night' term propagation onto the counting, the Sunken Cove / Stilllight Lantern name-plus-kind atoms and the Theme/Patient splits are doctrine-clean, as the reviewer says. Note that the sealed s2 bundle repeats the same bare-kind 'wintergloss' filler, so the definite-mass fix reaches it too.
